newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka ends marginally weaker vs dollar.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka ends marginally weaker vs dollar.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka closed marginally weaker at 43.7480/7500 to the dollar in a dull post-weekend interbank session on Sunday, against the previous close at 43.7400/7500, dealers said.
The local currency was quoted at 43.7400/7550 per dollar in early trade, but most deal were done at the 43.7500 level.
Dealers noted few trades as importers mostly remained absent due to the weekend closure of major international markets.
The call money traded at 8.0 to 11 percent, down from 9.0 to 16 percent previously, amid improving liquidity ahead of year end. -- Dhaka Newsroom +880-2-506363
